title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
summary: Return every string obtained by choosing one letter for each digit, in the given digit order.

contractDetails.output-checking: Require every distinct string once in any outer order.

statement: Return every string obtained by choosing one letter for each digit, in the given digit order. Use 2=abc, 3=def, 4=ghi, 5=jkl, 6=mno, 7=pqrs, 8=tuv, and 9=wxyz. Output order is free.
hints: Conceptual: Each digit supplies an independent group of choices.
Directional: Extend the current prefix using the letters for the next digit.
Implementation: Once every position has a letter, save the completed string.
complexityAnalysis: O(n·4ⁿ) time and O(n) auxiliary space excluding output, for n digits.
